purpose: Teach: 撲滅/亡くなる/身柄/漢方/災い/収縮/密輸/無差別

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の不正、本気で、絶対、撲滅、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to eradicate industry fraud. Not just aim for it — actually do it. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Weight on each directive. Leans forward slightly. The voice of someone who has seen what happens when standards slip. Steady eye contact. Not angry — something more serious than that.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者、本気で、絶対、亡くなる前、絶対、社員に、絶対、伝えた言葉、絶対、引き継いでまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Those words the founder spoke before he passed — about absolute integrity — I will carry that legacy forward with everything I have.
lines.style: Quiet reverence under the formality. He's invoking something sacred to him. Slower pace on the founder's words. Chest slightly open, like he's carrying weight with dignity. Gratitude is genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 機密の身柄、本気で、絶対、絶対、社外に、絶対、持ち出すな、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Confidential information stays confidential. Don't take it outside these walls. Not once, not ever.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped delivery on the key phrases. Hiroshi's jaw tightens slightly. Each sentence lands like a rule carved in stone. Pauses between clauses — letting the severity settle. Not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。漢方系の新事業、本気で、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're carefully studying our new herbal-medicine division. Every decision is being made with full transparency and caution.
lines.style: Careful, measured. Kenji knows this answer matters. He doesn't rush the words. There's precision here — he's showing he understands the weight of what he just committed to. Slight nod of acknowledgment built into the rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の災い、本気で、絶対、避けるよう、絶対、慎重に、絶対、判断しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Avoid industry pitfalls. I want you thinking clearly, moving cautiously. Judge every call with that in mind.
lines.style: Low, almost conversational in tone but unyielding in intent. Hiroshi sits back slightly — this isn't a lecture, it's a principle. Each word carries the gravity of experience. 'Cautiously' lands with particular emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の収縮、本気で、絶対、慎重に、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The market is tightening around us. We're responding to each shift carefully and methodically — staying ahead, not reactive.
lines.style: Kenji speaks with quiet competence. No defensiveness, just evidence that the work is being done. Steady tempo. The words 'carefully' and 'methodically' receive subtle emphasis — showing he's internalized Hiroshi's standard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、密輸、絶対、無縁、絶対、コンプラ、絶対、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: This company has nothing to do with smuggling, black markets, or cutting corners. That's not who we are. Make compliance the absolute standard — no exceptions.
lines.style: Forceful opening. Hiroshi's voice tightens around the prohibited acts, then unlocks slightly on the assertion of identity. The final directive is delivered with absolute clarity — a line drawn. Not harsh, just immovable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。無差別、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、対応、絶対、信頼関係、絶対、築いてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We treat every customer equally, with respect, and with the genuine goal of building trust that lasts. That's our foundation.
lines.style: Kenji's voice softens here — this is the principle he can affirm with real warmth. Slower pace on 'trust' and 'foundation.' He means it. This lands as a resolution, not just an agreement. Slight exhale of commitment at the close.
